facts.statement: SFO’s BART station is in the International Terminal; AirTrain connects airport terminals to BART.
facts.evidence: The BART station is located in the International Terminal

facts.statement: Adult Muni single-ride fare paid with Clipper is listed as $2.85.
An adult Muni single-ride fare covers 120 minutes of travel, subject to SFMTA conditions.
The Muni-only Day Pass is listed at $5.70 and covers Muni buses, trains and historic streetcars.
The one-day Visitor Passport is listed at $15.00; it includes Muni cable cars but excludes BART and SFO airport transportation.
The F Market & Wharves route lists stops at the Ferry Building and in Fisherman’s Wharf.
